item.description:
What changed in Etch

Etch 0.1.407

2026-10-11 · Build 407

  • Restore iCloud before seeding a new Mac.

Etch 0.1.406

2026-10-11 · Build 406

  • Retain check results while scheduling.
  • Restore calendar connection in signed releases.

Etch 0.1.405

2026-10-10 · Build 405

  • Updated Etch's bundled app and integrations.

Etch 0.1.404

2026-10-10 · Build 404

  • Automate signed releases and safe app updates.
  • Validate build and account sync lifecycle.
  • Review pass on connected apps — restricted mymind pulls, capped Reader syncs continue before moving the watermark, pulls that stop early say so.
  • Connected apps — Readwise Reader sync with highlights, mymind pull runs through your Claude connection, Connected apps in Sources.
  • Review pass on Readwise/mymind — highlight notes replace in place, mymind pull reads dates via get_objects, tolerant closing line, add_feed_clip race.
  • Readwise Reader and mymind as connected apps — Reader decoding, sync and highlights, mymind pull framing, clip external ids (v66; FD14, FD15).
  • Review pass on Sources — web rule off stops background fetches, highlight clears, long filing names truncate.
  • Sources panel — rule switches with live counts, mute projects/areas, follow sites and feeds, Read cards with images.
  • Review pass on web sources — date zone comments, no generic-word or heading matches, missing filing falls back home.
  • Review pass on clips in the app — paste never stolen from text fields, edits keep fresh previews, bounded image cache, PNG for transparency, head-only download.
  • Web fetch status stays on each Mac (no sync churn); saved Read cards keep link and image.
  • Review pass on clips — real </head> only, case-exact entities, peel wrapped links, file names stay notes.
  • Feed rules you can turn off, muted projects/areas, web sources (RSS/Atom/JSON Feed) ranked by relevance to your work (v65; FD12, FD13).
  • Add your own links and notes — Add sheet with live preview, rich cards, paste and drop, prefetch pending clips, image cache.
  • Feed clips — link metadata parser, clip store (v64, synced), list_feed_clips / add_feed_clip.
  • FeedClip and LinkMetadata contract; clip kinds.
  • Cache the saved-item task map; refresh saved task lookups on each load.
  • Hidden hub tabs stop counting as feed viewers; Overview feed rows are real buttons.
  • Review pass — whole-word role detection without claiming a job title, record-safe item ids for sync, project/area arg aliases on list_saved_feed_items.
  • Save cards, Saved list, Feed tab and "From your feed" on projects and areas; load only when seen.
  • No starter prompts in the file-revise composer.
  • Saved feed items (v63, synced), project/area context filter, list_saved_feed_items.

  • Global Feed in the sidebar — cards that say why, source filter, Not now, prompts for you.
